scope.rationale: Two new dispatchers (1 with shim pair, 1 net-new) + 1 lib.rs index bump. No architectural fork. Bounded to chronos-services + chronos-mcp. Spec authored in prior cycle (docs/milestones/m7-03-session-compare-explain-scoping.md). 4 reviewable work-unit commits.

new_dtos: SessionCompareInput { kind, session_a?, session_b?, baseline_session_id?, target_session_id?, top_n? }
SessionExplainOutput { Facts { bundle, provenance }, Derived { bundle, provenance }, Inferred { bundle, provenance }, Hypothesis { bundle, provenance } }
FactsBundle { session_id, event_count, duration_ms, thread_count, exit_status, issue_count, signal_count }
InferredTag enum { CrashDetected, IoHeavy, CpuBound, SingleThreaded, Unknown }
HypothesisTestPlan enum { CrashInvariant { session_id, comparison }, DominantFunctionCallPath { session_id, function, at_least_n } }
new_services: ChronosSessionCompareService::compare (kind-routed dispatcher; routes to ChronosDiffService::compare_sessions for divergence and ChronosDiffService::performance_regression_audit for regression)

ChronosSessionExplainService::explain (kind-routed dispatcher; loads session via SessionStore, runs QueryEngine::execution_summary, routes to build_facts / build_derived / build_inferred / build_hypothesis)
new_mcp_tools: session_compare (SessionCompareParams { kind, session_a, session_b, top_n? }, net-new v2)

v1_shim_routing.compare_sessions: SessionCompareParams { kind: 'divergence', session_a, session_b, top_n: None }
v1_shim_routing.performance_regression_audit: SessionCompareParams { kind: 'regression', session_a: baseline_session_id, session_b: target_session_id, top_n: top_n }

v1_json_shape_preserved.compare_sessions: Divergence variant is serialized via SessionCompareOutput::Divergence and includes all v1 fields (session_a_id, session_b_id, only_in_a_count, only_in_b_count, total_a, total_b, common_count, similarity_pct, timing_delta_ms, summary) plus provenance
v1_json_shape_preserved.performance_regression_audit: Regression variant is serialized via SessionCompareOutput::Regression preserving v1 perf_regression shape (baseline_session_id, target_session_id, threshold, top_n, regressions[]) plus provenance

known_limitations.reason: chronos_query::QueryEngine has no public engine_version() accessor. Matches the m7-02 observe.rs precedent. The string lives at module scope in each service and can be replaced by an accessor without changing DTO shape.

known_limitations.always: not exposed on the MCP wire shape
known_limitations.reason: Per m7-03 scoping §Decision 3: the dispatcher selects the plan based on what the bundle carries. hypothesis_kind is Option<...> in the underlying DTO so a future cycle can add the wire param without a breaking change.
known_limitations.future: m7+ if agents need to pick the hypothesis variant explicitly

known_limitations.field: session_explain build_inferred for sessions with only syscalls/signals
known_limitations.reason: Top functions list is empty for sessions without function events. Documented in session_explain.rs module docstring.

known_limitations.always: n/a — neither shim rewrites user-visible text. compare_sessions / performance_regression_audit keep their v1 JSON shape via SessionCompareOutput::Divergence / ::Regression variants
known_limitations.reason: V1 caller wire compatibility is preserved 1:1. The new 'provenance' field is added but cannot break v1 parsers since it never appeared before.

tests: e2e_connectivity (server starts and accepts a tool call — covers basic dispatcher plumbing)

smoke_subset_chosen.rationale: Compare + explain touch session storage + the dispatcher pattern that m7-02 (observe) established. e2e_connectivity is a free smoke. diff_tools is mandatory because both v1 shims route through it. analytics_tools covers the load_session path. hypothesis_tools verifies the new HypothesisTestPlan::DominantFunctionCallPath round-trips with hypothesis_test{kind=call_path}.

notes: Decisions locked in m7-03 scoping (1d218fb) carried over to execute cycle verbatim: hypothesis_kind not exposed on MCP wire, engine_version hardcoded, build_inferred Unknown fallback for empty top_functions, dispatch-session-compare shared helper for the v2 tool + 2 shims.

Both new dispatchers follow the observe.rs precedent (m7-02): tagged-enum kind discriminator, kind-gated field validation with ServiceError::InvalidInput, single dispatcher entry point with kind-routed match arms.

Shared helper Self::dispatch_session_compare is the only place that touches the wire error mapping; the v1 shims (compare_sessions / performance_regression_audit) and the v2 tool (session_compare) all funnel through it.

Test rig pattern: each module owns its #[cfg(test)] mod tests helper (no cross-module test helper imports). session_explain's make_event had to pass func.to_string() to both SourceLocation::new and EventData::Function::name — engine counts location.function, not EventData::Function::name.
parse_session_explain_kind + invalid_kind_error build a single rmcp::ErrorData::invalid_request for unknown kinds, so MCP tool wrappers surface a uniform error.
No clippy drift introduced; no module-level #[allow] needed.

ServiceError variants were NOT added this cycle. Reuse existing LoadFailed + InvalidInput — matches m6-01/m6-02/m6-03/m6-05 pattern. Surgical variants only when the new error class cannot be expressed via existing variants.
